deadline.value: UC Doctoral Scholarships, open to any discipline, close 15 May 2027 for a second-half 2027 start. The PhD itself has no stated closing date.
deadline.quote: for students planning to start in the second half of 2027; opens 20 March, closes 15 May

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: You need to arrange a supervisor and decide on a research project before you apply.
supervisor.quote: You need to arrange a supervisor and decide on a research project.

also.quote: PhD students must contact a potential supervisor before applying.

funding.value: Entry is competitive and scholarships are highly competitive, so funding is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Scholarships are highly competitive so make sure you begin the application

also.quote: Entry is competitive and grades do not guarantee acceptance into the degree programme.

entry_route.value: A research-focused honours or master's degree at First or Second Class Division I level is needed, so both routes are accepted.
entry_route.quote: Enrolment in a PhD requires completion of a research-focused honours or master’s degree, at First or Second Class (Division I) Honours or Distinction level (or equivalent qualifications).

notes: PhD - Biological Science page (School of Biological Sciences). Biochemistry, Microbiology, Cellular and Molecular Biology and Biotechnology are separate official PhD subjects and are not mapped here.
